verses.original: Θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ἡλίκον ἀγῶνα ἔχω ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ ὅσοι οὐχ ἑόρακαν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐν σαρκί
verses.transliteration: Thelō gar hymas eidenai hēlikon agōna echō hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia kai hosoi ouch heorakan to prosōpon mou en sarki
verses.literal: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea and for all who have not met me face to face . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: PORQUE quero que saibais quão grande combate tenho por vós, e pelos que estão em Laodicéia, e por quantos não viram o meu rosto em carne;

verses.original: ἵνα παρακληθῶσιν αἱ καρδίαι αὐτῶν συμβιβασθέντες ἐν ἀγάπῃ καὶ εἰς πᾶν πλοῦτος τῆς πληροφορίας τῆς συνέσεως εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina paraklēthōsin hai kardiai autōn symbibasthentes en agapē kai eis pan ploutos tēs plērophorias tēs syneseōs eis epignōsin tou mystēriou tou Theou Christou
verses.literal: that they may be encouraged - in heart knit together in love and filled with the full riches of complete understanding so that they may know the mystery of God namely Christ
verses.literalPt: Para que os seus corações sejam consolados, e estejam unidos em amor, e enriquecidos da plenitude da inteligência, para conhecimento do mistério de Deus e Pai, e de Cristo,

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ εἰσιν πάντες οἱ θησαυροὶ τῆς σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως ἀπόκρυφοι
verses.transliteration: en hō eisin pantes hoi thēsauroi tēs sophias kai gnōseōs apokryphoi
verses.literal: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
verses.literalPt: Em quem estão escondidos todos os tesouros da sabedoria e da ciência.

verses.original: Τοῦτο λέγω ἵνα μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς παραλογίζηται ἐν πιθανολογίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Touto legō hina mēdeis hymas paralogizētai en pithanologia
verses.literal: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric
verses.literalPt: E digo isto, para que ninguém vos engane com palavras persuasivas.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ καὶ τῇ σαρκὶ ἄπειμι ἀλλὰ τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι χαίρων καὶ βλέπων ὑμῶν τὴν τάξιν καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: ei gar kai tē sarki apeimi alla tō pneumati syn hymin eimi chairōn kai blepōn hymōn tēn taxin kai to stereōma tēs eis Christon pisteōs hymōn
verses.literal: For although . . . I am absent from you in body I am present with you in spirit and I delight to see your orderly condition and - firm faith in Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque, ainda que esteja ausente quanto ao corpo, contudo, em espírito estou convosco, regozijando-me e vendo a vossa ordem e a firmeza da vossa fé em Cristo.

verses.original: Ὡς οὖν παρελάβετε τὸν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν τὸν Κύριον ἐν αὐτῷ περιπατεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Hōs oun parelabete ton Christon Iēsoun ton Kyrion en autō peripateite
verses.literal: Therefore just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord continue to walk in Him
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, recebestes o Senhor Jesus Cristo, assim também andai nele,

verses.original: ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ ἐποικοδομούμενοι ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ βεβαιούμενοι τῇ πίστει καθὼς ἐδιδάχθητε περισσεύοντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ
verses.transliteration: errizōmenoi kai epoikodomoumenoi en autō kai bebaioumenoi tē pistei kathōs edidachthēte perisseuontes en eucharistia
verses.literal: rooted and built up in Him established in the faith as you were taught and overflowing with thankfulness
verses.literalPt: Arraigados e edificados nele, e confirmados na fé, assim como fostes ensinados, nela abundando em ação de graças.

verses.original: Βλέπετε μή τις ὑμᾶς ἔσται ὁ συλαγωγῶν διὰ τῆς φιλοσοφίας καὶ κενῆς ἀπάτης κατὰ τὴν παράδοσιν τῶν ἀνθρώπων κατὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τοῦ κόσμου καὶ οὐ κατὰ Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: Blepete mē tis hymas estai ho sylagōgōn dia tēs philosophias kai kenēs apatēs kata tēn paradosin tōn anthrōpōn kata ta stoicheia tou kosmou kai ou kata Christon
verses.literal: See to it that no one . . . . . . takes you captive . . . through philosophy and empty deception which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ
verses.literalPt: Tende cuidado, para que ninguém vos faça presa sua, por meio de filosofias e vãs sutilezas, segundo a tradição dos homens, segundo os rudimentos do mundo, e não segundo Cristo;

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ κατοικεῖ πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τῆς Θεότητος σωματικῶς
verses.transliteration: hoti en autō katoikei pan to plērōma tēs Theotētos sōmatikōs
verses.literal: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form
verses.literalPt: Porque nele habita corporalmente toda a plenitude da divindade;

verses.original: καὶ ἐστὲ ἐν αὐτῷ πεπληρωμένοι ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας
verses.transliteration: kai este en autō peplērōmenoi hos estin hē kephalē pasēs archēs kai exousias
verses.literal: And you have been made complete in Christ who is the head over every ruler and authority
verses.literalPt: E estais perfeitos nele, que é a cabeça de todo o principado e potestade;

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ περιετμήθητε περιτομῇ ἀχειροποιήτῳ ἐν τῇ ἀπεκδύσει τοῦ σώματος τῆς σαρκός ἐν τῇ περιτομῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: en hō kai perietmēthēte peritomē acheiropoiētō en tē apekdysei tou sōmatos tēs sarkos en tē peritomē tou Christou
verses.literal: In Him you were also circumcised in the putting off of your sinful nature . . . with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands
verses.literalPt: No qual também estais circuncidados com a circuncisão não feita por mão no despojo do corpo dos pecados da carne, a circuncisão de Cristo;

verses.original: συνταφέντες αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ βαπτισμῷ ἐν ᾧ καὶ συνηγέρθητε διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐνεργείας τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: syntaphentes autō en tō baptismō en hō kai synēgerthēte dia tēs pisteōs tēs energeias tou Theou tou egeirantos auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: And having been buried with Him in baptism - you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God who raised Him from the dead
verses.literalPt: Sepultados com ele no batismo, nele também ressuscitastes pela fé no poder de Deus, que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos.

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμᾶς νεκροὺς ὄντας ἐν τοῖς παραπτώμασιν καὶ τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν συνεζωοποίησεν ὑμᾶς σὺν αὐτῷ χαρισάμενος ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ παραπτώματα
verses.transliteration: Kai hymas nekrous ontas en tois paraptōmasin kai tē akrobystia tēs sarkos hymōn synezōopoiēsen hymas syn autō charisamenos hēmin panta ta paraptōmata
verses.literal: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature God made you alive with Christ He forgave us all our trespasses
verses.literalPt: E, quando vós estáveis mortos nos pecados, e na incircuncisão da vossa carne, vos vivificou juntamente com ele, perdoando-vos todas as ofensas,

verses.original: ἐξαλείψας τὸ καθ’ ἡμῶν χειρόγραφον τοῖς δόγμασιν ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον ἡμῖν καὶ αὐτὸ ἦρκεν ἐκ τοῦ μέσου προσηλώσας αὐτὸ τῷ σταυρῷ
verses.transliteration: exaleipsas to kath’ hēmōn cheirographon tois dogmasin ho ēn hypenantion hēmin kai auto ērken ek tou mesou prosēlōsas auto tō staurō
verses.literal: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us He took it away . . . . . . nailing it to the cross
verses.literalPt: Havendo riscado a cédula que era contra nós nas suas ordenanças, a qual de alguma maneira nos era contrária, e a tirou do meio de nós, cravando-a na cruz.

verses.original: ἀπεκδυσάμενος τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας ἐδειγμάτισεν ἐν παρρησίᾳ θριαμβεύσας αὐτοὺς ἐν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: apekdysamenos tas archas kai tas exousias edeigmatisen en parrēsia thriambeusas autous en autō
verses.literal: And having disarmed the powers and authorities He made a public spectacle of them . . . . . . triumphing over them by the cross
verses.literalPt: E, despojando os principados e potestades, os expôs publicamente e deles triunfou em si mesmo.

verses.original: Μὴ οὖν τις ὑμᾶς κρινέτω ἐν βρώσει καὶ ἐν πόσει ἢ ἐν μέρει ἑορτῆς ἢ νεομηνίας ἢ σαββάτων
verses.transliteration: Mē oun tis hymas krinetō en brōsei kai en posei ē en merei heortēs ē neomēnias ē sabbatōn
verses.literal: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink or with regard to a feast a New Moon or a Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Portanto, ninguém vos julgue pelo comer, ou pelo beber, ou por causa dos dias de festa, ou da lua nova, ou dos sábados,

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν σκιὰ τῶν μελλόντων τὸ δὲ σῶμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ha estin skia tōn mellontōn to de sōma tou Christou
verses.literal: These are a shadow of the things to come but the body that casts it belongs to Christ
verses.literalPt: Que são sombras das coisas futuras, mas o corpo é de Cristo.

verses.original: μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς καταβραβευέτω θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ θρησκείᾳ τῶν ἀγγέλων ἃ ἑόρακεν ἐμβατεύων εἰκῇ φυσιούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ νοὸς τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: mēdeis hymas katabrabeuetō thelōn en tapeinophrosynē kai thrēskeia tōn angelōn ha heoraken embateuōn eikē physioumenos hypo tou noos tēs sarkos autou
verses.literal: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind
verses.literalPt: Ninguém vos domine a seu bel-prazer com pretexto de humildade e culto dos anjos, envolvendo-se em coisas que não viu; estando debalde inchado na sua carnal compreensão,

verses.original: καὶ οὐ κρατῶν τὴν Κεφαλήν ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα διὰ τῶν ἁφῶν καὶ συνδέσμων ἐπιχορηγούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον αὔξει τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ou kratōn tēn Kephalēn ex hou pan to sōma dia tōn haphōn kai syndesmōn epichorēgoumenon kai symbibazomenon auxei tēn auxēsin tou Theou
verses.literal: He has lost connection to the head from whom the whole body supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments grows as God causes it to grow
verses.literalPt: E não ligado à cabeça, da qual todo o corpo, provido e organizado pelas juntas e ligaduras, vai crescendo em aumento de Deus.

verses.original: Εἰ ἀπεθάνετε σὺν Χριστῷ ἀπὸ τῶν στοιχείων τοῦ κόσμου τί ὡς ζῶντες ἐν κόσμῳ δογματίζεσθε
verses.transliteration: Ei apethanete syn Christō apo tōn stoicheiōn tou kosmou ti hōs zōntes en kosmō dogmatizesthe
verses.literal: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world why as though you still belonged to the world do you submit to its regulations
verses.literalPt: Se, pois, estais mortos com Cristo quanto aos rudimentos do mundo, por que vos carregam ainda de ordenanças, como se vivêsseis no mundo, tais como:

verses.original: Μὴ ἅψῃ μηδὲ γεύσῃ μηδὲ θίγῃς
verses.transliteration: Mē hapsē mēde geusē mēde thigēs
verses.literal: Do not handle do not taste do not touch
verses.literalPt: Não toques, não proves, não manuseies?

verses.original: ἅ ἐστιν πάντα εἰς φθορὰν τῇ ἀποχρήσει κατὰ τὰ ἐντάλματα καὶ διδασκαλίας τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: ha estin panta eis phthoran tē apochrēsei kata ta entalmata kai didaskalias tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: These will all perish with use because they are based on human commands and teachings
verses.literalPt: As quais coisas todas perecem pelo uso, segundo os preceitos e doutrinas dos homens;

verses.original: ἅτινά ἐστιν λόγον μὲν ἔχοντα σοφίας ἐν ἐθελοθρησκίᾳ καὶ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀφειδίᾳ σώματος οὐκ ἐν τιμῇ τινι πρὸς πλησμονὴν τῆς σαρκός
verses.transliteration: hatina estin logon men echonta sophias en ethelothrēskia kai tapeinophrosynē kai apheidia sōmatos ouk en timē tini pros plēsmonēn tēs sarkos
verses.literal: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom with their self-prescribed worship their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh
verses.literalPt: As quais têm, na verdade, alguma aparência de sabedoria, em devoção voluntária, humildade, e em disciplina do corpo, mas não são de valor algum senão para a satisfação da carne.
